subproblem.title: Lipschitz push-forwards of integer multiplicity currents are integer multiplicity, given (S5′) (supplied 2.6, 5.9; parent I.7)
subproblem.statement: Assume (S5′), verbatim the premise of the parent statement: for all P, Q, k, every X = τ(M, θ, ξ) ∈ D_k(ℝ^P) (IsRectifiableTriple univ k M θ ξ, θ natural-valued on M, X(ω) = tauAction k M θ ξ ω for all ω) and every Λ-Lipschitz g : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q with g⁻¹(K) ∩ spt X compact for compact K, there is S ∈ D_k(ℝ^Q) with IsLipschitzPushforward X g S, IsIntegerMultiplicity S, and ∫_M θ(x)·nVectorPushforward k (fderiv ℝ g_j x) (ξ x) (ω(g_j x)) dH^k(x) → S(ω) for every sequence of C¹ maps g_j with a common Lipschitz bound converging uniformly to g and every ω. For g : ℝ^p → ℝ^q, ω ∈ D^j(ℝ^q), η ∈ D^j(ℝ^p) and A ⊆ ℝ^p, 'η is compatible with (g, ω) near A' means: there is an open N ⊇ A with η(x) = ω(g(x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ g x) for all x ∈ N. For X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m), G : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} and S ∈ D_k(ℝ^{m′}), LipPF(X, G, S) means: for every sequence (G_n) of C^∞ maps ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)), every open O ⊇ spt X and every L ∈ ℝ such that eventually ‖fderiv ℝ G_n x‖ ≤ L for all x ∈ O, and G_n → G uniformly on O, and for every ω ∈ D^k(ℝ^{m′}) and every sequence (η_n) in D^k(ℝ^m) such that eventually η_n is compatible with (G_n, ω) near spt X, the sequence X(η_n) converges to S(ω). Then for all m, m′, k ∈ ℕ, every integer multiplicity X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m), G : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′}, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, r > 0 such that G is Λ-Lipschitz on thickening r (spt X) and G⁻¹(K) ∩ spt X is compact for every compact K, and every S ∈ D_k(ℝ^{m′}) with LipPF(X, G, S): S is integer multiplicity.
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (P Q k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k M θ ξ → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ j : ℕ, θ x = j) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k, X ω = tauAction k M θ ξ ω) → ∀ (g : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Λ : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith Λ g → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → IsCompact (g ⁻¹' K ∩ X.support)) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl Q)) k, IsLipschitzPushforward X g S ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ ∀ (gj : ℕ → Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Λ' : ℝ≥0), (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (gj j)) → (∀ j, LipschitzWith Λ' (gj j)) → TendstoUniformly gj g atTop → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl Q)) k, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in M, θ x * nVectorPushforward k (fderiv ℝ (gj j) x) (ξ x) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) k) (gj j x)) ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) atTop (𝓝 (S ω))) → ∀ (m m' k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k) (G : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Λ : ℝ≥0) (r : ℝ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → 0 < r → LipschitzOnWith Λ G (thickening r X.support) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (G ⁻¹' K ∩ X.support)) → (∀ (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m') (O : Set (Eucl m)) (L : ℝ), IsOpen O → X.support ⊆ O → (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj n)) → (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x‖ ≤ L) → TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop O → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (ηj : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (ηj n : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (Gj n x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x)) → Tendsto (fun n => X (ηj n)) atTop (𝓝 (S ω))) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: items 2.6 (rectifiable representation of smooth push-forwards: g_#X(ω) = X(η) = ∫_M θ⟨ω(g(x)), Dg(x)_#ξ(x)⟩ dH^k, using H^k(M ∖ spt X) = 0) and 5.9 (integrality of Lipschitz push-forwards through the premise (S5′); parent I.7) of the supplied proof of deformation_pushforward_homotopy. The premise (S5′) of this child is verbatim the premise of the parent statement (the conclusion of the sibling deformation_im_pushforward_limit after its premise LipschitzPushforwardIntegerMultiplicity).

Notation. As in the sibling lipschitz_pushforward: locally admissible sequences (G_n, O, L) and the property LipPF(X, G, S) of the statement; A_ρ := thickening ρ A; H^k := μHE[k]. Reused facts: (R3) compatible_form (iwl_sp_exists_compatible_testForm); (R5) support_null (iwl_sp_rectifiable_support_null): if IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ and T(ω) = tauAction k M θ ξ ω for all ω, then H^k(M ∖ spt T) = 0; sibling smooth_approx (N1).

1. (Representation.) X is integer multiplicity: there are M, θ, ξ with IsRectifiableTriple univ k M θ ξ, θ(x) ∈ ℕ for x ∈ M (as ∃ j : ℕ, θ x = j) and X(ω) = tauAction k M θ ξ ω for all ω.

2. (Approximations.) Apply smooth_approx (N1) with A := spt X and δ := r: there are Ĝ : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′}, L ≥ 0 and maps G_n with Ĝ L-Lipschitz, Ĝ = G on (spt X)_r, each G_n C^∞ and L-Lipschitz, G_n → Ĝ uniformly on ℝ^m, and ‖DG_n(x)‖ ≤ Λ for x ∈ O₀ := (spt X)_{r/2}. Since Ĝ = G on O₀, (G_n, O₀, Λ) is locally admissible for (X, G) (O₀ open, spt X ⊆ O₀, uniform convergence to G on O₀).

3. (Apply (S5′).) Ĝ is L-Lipschitz, and Ĝ⁻¹(K) ∩ spt X = G⁻¹(K) ∩ spt X is compact for compact K (Ĝ = G on spt X ⊆ (spt X)_r). Applying (S5′) to P := m, Q := m′, k, X, (M, θ, ξ), g := Ĝ, Λ := L gives S′ ∈ D_k(ℝ^{m′}) with IsIntegerMultiplicity S′ and: for every sequence (g_n) of C¹ maps with a common Lipschitz bound converging uniformly to Ĝ and every ω, ∫_M θ(x)·nVectorPushforward k (Dg_n(x)) (ξ(x)) (ω(g_n x)) dH^k(x) → S′(ω). Take g_n := G_n: C^∞ implies C¹ (ContDiff.of_le), the common Lipschitz bound is L, and G_n → Ĝ uniformly. Hence for every ω:
 (∗) I_n(ω) := ∫_M θ(x)·nVectorPushforward k (DG_n(x)) (ξ(x)) (ω(G_n x)) dH^k(x) → S′(ω).

4. (Rectifiable formula, 2.6.) Choose n₀ with |G_n − G| ≤ 1 on spt X for n ≥ n₀ (uniform convergence on O₀ ⊇ spt X). For n ≥ n₀, G_n is proper on spt X (G_n⁻¹(K) ∩ spt X is closed and contained in the compact G⁻¹(cthickening 1 K) ∩ spt X), so (R3) (U = V = univ, A = spt X) gives, for each ω, a form η_n ∈ D^k(ℝ^m) compatible with (G_n, ω) near spt X, on an open N_n ⊇ spt X. By (R5), H^k(M ∖ spt X) = 0, so for H^k-a.e. x ∈ M we have x ∈ spt X ⊆ N_n and
 η_n(x) = ω(G_n x).compContinuousLinearMap(DG_n(x)) = covectorPullback k (DG_n(x)) (ω(G_n x)),
 hence ξ(x)(η_n(x)) = (ξ(x) ∘ covectorPullback k (DG_n(x)))(ω(G_n x)) = nVectorPushforward k (DG_n(x)) (ξ(x)) (ω(G_n x)) by the definition nVectorPushforward k L w = w.comp (covectorPullback k L). Therefore (integral_congr_ae for the measure H^k⌞M)
 X(η_n) = tauAction k M θ ξ η_n = ∫_M θ(x)ξ(x)(η_n(x)) dH^k(x) = I_n(ω) (n ≥ n₀).

5. (Identification.) For n ≥ n₀ the η_n are compatible with (G_n, ω) near spt X, so LipPF(X, G, S) applied to the locally admissible (G_n, O₀, Λ) gives X(η_n) → S(ω) (set η_n := 0 for n < n₀; compatibility is only required eventually). By step 4 and (∗), X(η_n) = I_n(ω) → S′(ω). Limits in ℝ are unique, so S(ω) = S′(ω) for all ω, S = S′ (GeometricCurrentOn.ext), and S is integer multiplicity. ∎
proof_key_steps: smooth_approx on (spt X)_r gives a Lipschitz extension Ĝ and C^∞ maps G_n → Ĝ uniformly with a common Lipschitz bound and ‖DG_n‖ ≤ Λ near spt X; they are locally admissible for (X, G).
(S5′) for (X, M, θ, ξ, Ĝ) gives an integer multiplicity S′ with ∫_M θ⟨ω(G_n), DG_n#ξ⟩ dH^k → S′(ω).
2.6: for η_n compatible with (G_n, ω) near spt X, X(η_n) equals that integral because H^k(M ∖ spt X) = 0 (support_null) and ξ(η_n) = nVectorPushforward k (DG_n) ξ (ω∘G_n) on spt X.
LipPF gives X(η_n) → S(ω); hence S = S′ is integer multiplicity.
